why.T3-023: The whole sub is turned into something else for the day and played inside: it is renamed and rededicated to Marc Merrill with a new look and flairs (c0085 'This subreddit is from here on out, dedicated to ... Marc Merrill, and we are all his loyal subjects', c0086 'select your very own Marc Merrill flair', c0088 'supportive of these changes'), it is described as transforming itself for April 1st (c0188, c0589, c1600), and a designer says the new theme was prepared in Merrill's honor (c0259); the great bulk of the concepts are members playing inside that change (hails, AMAs, petitions, flairs, Merrill posts). It is not T3-001, because the fakes here are the makeover's own play, and not T3-048, because the maker's joke is only one block within it.
why.T3-032: Objection to the room's April Fools content is carried by well over three concepts: 'THIS IS UTTER CANCER, PLZ MAKE IT STOP' (c0263), 'Another unoriginal and weak april fools' (c0281), 'this shit is so fucking cringe' (c0481), 'I'm really uncomfortable with the whole The_Donald imitation' (c1445), 'hands down the stupidest shit I have ever seen' (c1613), 'wasn't even remotely funny' (c1632), plus c0191 and c1435; the scheme's T3-023 rule adds T3-032 when the objecting has three or more concepts, and these object to the jokes rather than to the styling being hard to read (T3-097), which has only one concept (c0095).
why.T3-048: A distinct block of members reacts to the April Fools jokes of the company the sub follows — Riot's fake Yasuo patch notes with the endless windwall (c1016, c1021 'Then I saw the windwall and realized it was April fools', c1025 'Good April fool prank Rito', c1044 'the real April Fool's joke is that it's actually getting implemented', c1048), the fake-buff jokes (c1020, c1046, c1785) and the new bots rolled out for the day (c1817, c1819, c1822, c0863) — judging and comparing the maker's own joke, which the makeover placement (T3-023) does not carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-023 carries the restyled, renamed sub and the roleplay inside it, but it does not carry the sustained objection to those jokes carried by more than three concepts (c0263, c0281, c0481, c1445, c1613, c1632), nor the judging of Riot's own April Fools (the fake Yasuo patch notes and the new bots: c1016, c1021, c1025, c1044, c1817), which are the maker's joke and not the sub's changed state.

why.T3-014: The room's canvas planning is carried on in its own chat rather than in the thread: members plan through the general Ace Combat Discord (c0030). That is the chat as the room's own planning place (T3-014), not a megathread inside the sub (T3-015), not a new sub (T3-090), not a chat whose decisions are relayed back (T3-152) or disputed (T3-114), and not where other rooms are met (T3-153).
why.T3-062: Besides the chat, the room gets the logo built by carrying its call into other communities: a member messages the mods of r/murica to enlist their aid (c0035) and the room afterwards says it could not have been done without them (c0041). The aid is recruited from other communities' membership, which is T3-062, not T3-084 (another canvas room asked as a group) and not T3-002 (the room's own members called).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-014 carries only the venue where planning happened (c0030); it does not carry the room's call for hands taken into another community (c0035) or the credit given to that outside help (c0041), which the scheme places with T3-062.

why.T3-023: The sub as a whole is turned into something else for April Fools by its moderators and played inside: it is renamed (c0197 '/r/dota2 is now /r/tz', c0255, c0631), restyled with RTZ faces, banners and flairs (c0226, c0419, c0477, c0480) and given a talent tree and a posting rule (c0198, c0258 'Posts not related to rtz will be deleted', c0360), and members play inside it (rtzW, RTZ chants, petitions, devotional posts). That is T3-023, not T3-001: the joke is the sub's changed state, with the replies inside it.
why.T3-032: Objection to the room's April Fools jokes is carried by more than three concepts: 'april fools day fucking blows' (c0200), 'Even as a joke, this is bullshit' (c0205), 'it's april 2nd, stop the retardness' (c0206), 'the banner is cancer ... CAN YOU OPEN YOUR EYES' (c0437), 'Remove this bullshit subreddit theme' (c0467), c0349, c0642, c0649, c0656, c1656; the T3-023 rule adds T3-032 when the objecting has three or more concepts, and the objection is to the jokes themselves rather than to a styling that is hard to read.
why.T3-100: Members ask that the April Fools change outlive the day: 'YOU BETTER NOT REMOVE THIS AFTER APRIL 1 MODS' (c0202), 'please let us keep our rtzFlairs forever' (c0262), 'Can this RTZ theme stay after April's Fools?' (c0369), a petition for the subreddit to be permanently named /r/tz (c0405), 'PETITION TO KEEP THE RTZ FLAIRS' (c0529); the T3-023 rule adds T3-100 when the asking to keep has concepts of its own, and this is not T3-097 (turning the look off: c0204, c0650).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-023 carries the renamed, restyled and re-ruled sub and the play inside it, but not the objection carried by more than three concepts (c0200, c0205, c0206, c0437, c0467, c0649) nor the requests that the name, theme and flairs stay past the day (c0202, c0262, c0369, c0405, c0529), which the scheme's T3-023 rule assigns to T3-032 and T3-100.
